default: absent; schema format and ordinary tester ranks select the applicable renderer
effect: requests radio, cards, table, password, date/time, color, Cron, duration, or code presentation where the target schema and renderer family support it; does not rewrite or validate the data schema
precedence: local UI format participates in tester ranking independently of schema format; flat config.format does not select a specialized renderer; temporal UI formats require string data, while table requires an array and code conversion has its explicit JSON object gate
